game.name: 007 Legends (Russia)
game.desc: Bond is hit by a sniper and recalls previous missions in flashbacks. All the chapters are therefore independent, set in the present day and featuring Craig as the protagonist. The game's basic premise is similar to that of other shooters of the time: linear levels with lots of enemies to kill and a cover system. The game also features a basic stealth system that is not compulsory for most missions. There are also rail-shooting missions, driving and hand-to-hand combat with bosses. Players can choose between automatic healing and the classic mechanic of collecting items to replenish health and armour.
